content.comment_body: It would be helpful if the manual provided clearer information. I recently purchased a [product_name] thinking it would have 2 analog inputs, only to realize it does not. I spent an entire day trying to figure out why AI1 and AI2 were not functioning, which left me quite frustrated. The documentation led me to believe that all models were identical and would support these features.

Hello [user_name], there isn't a '[product_name]' model called "LOGO12RCE"; rather, it is a [product_name] 12/24RCE. This version has 8 inputs, with 4 usable as analog inputs (0-10 VDC). The base module details specify how many analog input addresses are accessible, with the default being 2 analog inputs available at certain terminals. The available configuration options are: - 0 AI: No analog input address is reserved for the module. - 2 AI: Two addresses are reserved for the module. - 4 AI: Four addresses are reserved. You can check the specifics of your base module in its documentation for more details.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing confusion and frustration due to ambiguous documentation about the analog input capabilities in the [product_name] series. This misunderstanding arises from unclear descriptions, resulting in users spending unnecessary time troubleshooting and highlighting the need for more precise product guidance.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear and direct documentation that explicitly states which models support specific features, such as analog inputs, to avoid wasting time on troubleshooting capabilities that may not be present.
